skills.title: Keep track of objects by making one mark for each object

expectations: One mark stands for exactly one object, big or small

items.answer: One mark not crossed off, so one cow is still out
hints: What happens to a mark when its cow comes back?
Each cow that returns crosses off one mark.
6 marks, only 5 crossed off, so ___ mark is left.
One mark stays, so one cow has not come back.

items.prompt_en: There are 7 pebbles in the bag for 7 goats. In the evening you take out one pebble for each goat that comes in, and the bag becomes empty. Is any goat missing?
items.prompt_hi: Thaile mein 7 bakriyon ke 7 kankad hain. Shaam ko har aati bakri ke liye ek kankad nikaalo, aur thaila khaali ho gaya. Kya koi bakri gum hai?
items.answer: No, all the goats are back
hints: What does an empty bag tell you?

No goat is missing: every pebble was matched.

acceptable: A mein 2 gum, B mein ek extra

items.prompt_en: Long ago there were no number names. A fisherman takes his boats out in the morning. How can he use small stones to check in the evening that every boat is back?

Use one stone for one boat.
